section.content: 本实用新型涉及一种锂离子电池，包括极芯、软包壳体和热保护器，软包壳体包括第一半壳、第二半壳和封边，极芯上引出极性不同的第一极耳和第二极耳；热保护器包括保护器主体、第一连接件和第二连接件，第二连接件包括连接段和引出段，保护器主体位于封边的厚度方向上的一侧面，第一连接件连接第一极耳和保护器主体的一侧，连接段的一端连接在保护器主体的另一侧，连接段的另一端翻折至封边的厚度方向上的另一侧面，并与引出段连接，引出段沿第二极耳的延伸方向延伸。与现有技术相比，保护器主体和引出段分别设置在封边的相对的两侧面，通过封边对保护器主体和引出段进行隔离，防止保护器主体温度过高导致断路，提升了热保护器的电流过流值。

The utility model relates to a lithium ion battery, which comprises a pole core, a soft package shell and a thermal protector, wherein the soft package shell comprises a first half shell, a second half shell and a sealing edge, and a first pole lug and a second pole lug with different polarities are led out from the pole core; the thermal protector comprises a protector main body, a first connecting piece and a second connecting piece, wherein the second connecting piece comprises a connecting section and a leading-out section, the protector main body is positioned on one side surface in the thickness direction of the sealed edge, the first connecting piece is connected with one side of a first electrode lug and the protector main body, one end of the connecting section is connected to the other side of the protector main body, the other end of the connecting section is turned over to the other side surface in the thickness direction of the sealed edge and is connected with the leading-out section, and the leading-out section extends along the extending direction of the second electrode lug. Compared with the prior art, the protector main part sets up respectively at the relative both sides face of banding with drawing forth the section, keeps apart the protector main part and draws forth the section through the banding, prevents that protector main part high temperature from resulting in opening a circuit, has promoted hot protector's current overcurrent value.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The utility model belongs to the technical field of batteries, and particularly relates to a lithium ion battery.

Background

Lithium ion batteries have been widely used in the 3C field (e.g., mobile phones, notebook computers, smart wearing, etc.) due to their high voltage, high energy density, long cycle life, and low self-discharge. Common 3C field consumer batteries have two typical features and trends:

1) the 3C product is in close contact with a consumer for a long time, the consumer has high requirements on the safety of the product, and if the notebook computer requires that all the battery cells for shipment need to be welded with a thermal protector (TCO) so as to ensure the safety of the product;

2) under the common promotion of continuous development and popularization of a 5G technology, continuous iteration and upgrade of product hardware and software, use requirements of consumers and product bright spot mining, the battery is required to continuously work at a larger current (for example, when the game book works, the battery is required to continuously work at a larger current to ensure the game experience of the users).

The two characteristics contradict each other to the characteristic demand of battery, and the product after welding the thermal protector has the requirement to the electric current of discharging, and after exceeding required current value, the inside double click sheetmetal of thermal protector can move and turn off the discharge circuit and can't continue to discharge during discharge, can cause the product to shut down in advance, data loss and the poor use phenomenon of product experience effect, arouse consumer batch complaint. However, the iterative upgrade of product hardware and software, and the requirement of the battery to continuously work at a larger current in a specific operation mode (such as the operation of a violent game), if the battery cannot work at a large current, will affect the aspects of product market positioning, bright spot publicity, customer experience and the like, and reduce the competitive advantage of the product.

The thermal protector comprises a protector main body and nickel sheets connected to two sides of the protector main body. The existing thermal protector for processing the lithium ion battery usually adopts F-shaped switching (as shown in figure 1), the requirement of the thermal protector for the F-shaped switching on the width size of the battery is small, the narrow battery can realize the placement and processing of the thermal protector, but the internal resistance is large, and the folded nickel sheet needs to pass through the upper part of the protector main body (refer to figure 1), the temperature rise of the nickel sheet can be transmitted to the protector main body during discharging, so that the temperature at the position of the protector main body is overhigh, and the overcurrent value of the current is lower.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The technical problem to be solved by the utility model is as follows: the lithium ion battery is provided aiming at the problem that the current overcurrent value of the existing thermal protector of the lithium ion battery is lower.

In order to solve the technical problem, an embodiment of the present invention provides a lithium ion battery, including a pole core, a soft package shell and a thermal protector, where the soft package shell includes a first half shell, a second half shell and a sealing edge, the first half shell and the second half shell are connected in a sealing manner through the sealing edge to form a sealed cavity at inner sides of the first half shell and the second half shell, the pole core is accommodated in the sealed cavity, a first tab and a second tab with different polarities are led out from the pole core, the first tab penetrates out of the soft package shell through the sealing edge, and the second tab penetrates out of the soft package shell through the sealing edge;

the hot protector includes protector main part, first connecting piece and second connecting piece, the second connecting piece includes the linkage segment and draws forth the section, the protector main part is located the ascending side of thickness direction of banding, the first end of first connecting piece with first utmost point ear is connected, the second end of first connecting piece is connected one side of protector main part, the first end of linkage segment is connected the opposite side of protector main part, the second end of linkage segment turns over to turn over to the ascending another side of thickness direction of banding, and with the first end of drawing forth the section is connected, the second end of drawing forth the section is followed the extending direction of second utmost point ear extends.

Optionally, soft-packing casing is square shell, first half shell lid closes half shell of second is last, the first side of first half shell with the first side of half shell of second is even as an organic whole, the banding includes first banding and connects the second banding at first banding both ends, first banding is connected the side relative with first side of first half shell, the second banding is connected the side adjacent with first side of first half shell, first utmost point ear with the second utmost point ear is followed first banding is worn out, the protector main part with it sets up respectively to draw forth the section relative both sides face in the thickness direction of first banding.

Optionally, the connecting section is folded around one side of the first sealing edge in the width direction.

Optionally, the connecting section is folded around one side of the first sealing edge in the length direction.

Optionally, one end of the second sealing edge close to the first sealing edge is folded to be attached to the first sealing edge, and is located between the first sealing edge and the connecting section.

Optionally, the leading-out section extends along the extending direction of the first sealed edge, and extends along the extending direction of the second tab from the position of the first tab, where the first tab penetrates through the sealed edge.

Optionally, the connection section and the lead-out section are integrally formed.

Optionally, the first connecting piece and the second connecting piece are both made of a copper-nickel alloy.

Optionally, the first connecting member is welded to the first tab.

Optionally, the first tab penetrates out of the soft package shell and then bends towards the pole core in the opposite direction.

Compared with the prior art, the lithium ion battery provided by the embodiment of the utility model has the advantages that the protector main body and the leading-out section are respectively arranged on the two opposite side surfaces of the sealing edge, and compared with the thermal protector with the leading-out section directly attached to the protector main body, the protector main body and the leading-out section are isolated by the sealing edge, so that the heat generated by the leading-out section is prevented from being directly transmitted to the protector main body, the temperature of the protector main body is reduced, the broken circuit caused by overhigh temperature of the protector main body is prevented, and the current overcurrent value of the thermal protector is increased, so that the current overcurrent value of the lithium ion battery is increased, and the lithium ion battery can continuously work at a larger current.

The reference numerals in the specification are as follows:

1. a soft package housing; 11. a first half shell; 12. a second half shell; 13. sealing edges; 131. first edge sealing; 132. second edge sealing;

2. a thermal protector; 21. a protector main body; 22. a first connecting member; 23. a second connecting member;

231. a connecting section; 232. a lead-out section;

3. a first tab; 4. and a second tab.

Detailed Description

In order to make the technical problems, technical solutions and advantageous effects solved by the present invention more clearly apparent, the present invention is further described in detail below with reference to the accompanying drawings and embodiments. It should be understood that the specific embodiments described herein are merely illustrative of the utility model and are not intended to limit the utility model.

As shown in fig. 2 to 7, the lithium ion battery provided by the embodiment of the present invention includes a pole core, a soft package casing 1 and a thermal protector 2, where the soft package casing 1 includes a first half casing 11, a second half casing 12 and a sealing edge 13, the first half casing 11 and the second half casing 12 are hermetically connected by the sealing edge 13 to form a sealed cavity at the inner sides of the first half casing 11 and the second half casing 12, the pole core is accommodated in the sealed cavity, a first tab 3 and a second tab 4 with different polarities are led out from the pole core, the first tab 3 penetrates out of the soft package casing 1 from the sealing edge 13, and the second tab 4 penetrates out of the soft package casing 1 from the sealing edge 13;

thermal protector 2 includes protector main part 21, first connecting piece 22 and second connecting piece 23, second connecting piece 23 includes linkage segment 231 and draws forth section 232, protector main part 21 is located the ascending side of the thickness direction of banding 13, the first end of first connecting piece 22 is connected with first utmost point ear 3, the one side at protector main part 21 is connected to the second end of first connecting piece 22, the opposite side at protector main part 21 is connected to the first end of linkage segment 231, the second end of linkage segment 231 turns over the another side that turns over to the thickness direction of banding 13, and be connected with the first end of drawing forth section 232, the second end of drawing forth section 232 extends along the extending direction of second utmost point ear 4.

In the lithium ion battery provided by the embodiment of the utility model, the protector main body 21 and the lead-out section 232 are respectively arranged on two opposite side surfaces of the sealing edge 13, compared with the thermal protector 2 in which the lead-out section 232 is directly attached to the protector main body 21, the protector main body 21 and the lead-out section 232 are isolated by the sealing edge 13, so that heat generated by the lead-out section 232 is prevented from being directly transmitted to the protector main body 21, the temperature of the protector main body 21 is reduced, the protector main body 21 is prevented from being broken due to overhigh temperature, the current overcurrent value of the thermal protector 2 is increased, the current overcurrent value of the lithium ion battery is increased, and the lithium ion battery can continuously work with larger current.

In an embodiment, as shown in fig. 2, the soft package casing 1 is a square casing, the first half casing 11 covers the second half casing 12, the first side edge of the first half casing 11 is connected with the first side edge of the second half casing 12 into a whole, the sealing edge 13 includes a first sealing edge 131 and a second sealing edge 132 connected to two ends of the first sealing edge 131, the first sealing edge 131 is connected to a side edge of the first half casing 11 opposite to the first side edge, the second sealing edge 132 is connected to a side edge of the first half casing 11 adjacent to the first side edge, the first tab 3 and the second tab 4 penetrate through the first sealing edge 131, and the protector main body 21 and the lead-out section 232 are respectively disposed on two opposite side surfaces in the thickness direction of the first sealing edge 131. The packaging of the first half shell 11 and the second half shell 12 is facilitated, the sealing performance of the sealing cavity is improved, and the performance of the lithium ion battery is improved.

Preferably, the soft package case 1 is made of an aluminum plastic composite film.

Preferably, the first half-shell 11 and the second half-shell 12 are molded on the same aluminum-plastic composite film.

In one embodiment, as shown in fig. 2 to 4, the connection section 231 is folded around one side of the first sealing edge 131 in the width direction. The processing technology is simple, the processing difficulty is reduced, and the mass production is convenient.

In one embodiment, as shown in fig. 5 to 7, one end of the second sealing edge 132 connected to the first sealing edge 131 is folded inward, and the connection section 231 is folded around one side of the first sealing edge 131 in the length direction. The contact area between the second connecting piece 23 and the sealing edge 13 is increased, the heat of the second connecting piece 23 is transferred to the sealing edge 13, the heat dissipation of the second connecting piece 23 is facilitated, the processing technology is simple, the processing difficulty is reduced, and the mass production is facilitated

In one embodiment, as shown in fig. 5 to 7, an end of the second sealing edge 132 close to the first sealing edge 131 is folded to be attached to the first sealing edge 131 and located between the first sealing edge 131 and the connecting section 231. The connecting section 231 can be folded around one side of the first sealing edge 131 in the length direction, so that the connecting section 231 can be better attached to the first sealing edge 131, and the connecting section 231 can be folded conveniently.

In one embodiment, as shown in fig. 3, the lead-out section 232 extends along the extending direction of the first sealing edge 131 and extends along the extending direction of the second tab 4 from the position of the first tab 3, which penetrates out of the sealing edge 13. The electrode leading-out position of the lithium ion battery after the thermal protector 2 is installed is consistent with that before the thermal protector 2 is installed, and the lithium ion battery is convenient to connect with other electronic equipment.

In one embodiment, as shown in fig. 4, the connection section 231 and the lead-out section 232 are integrally formed. The integral strength of the second connecting piece 23 is improved, the second connecting piece 23 is prevented from being broken, the processing difficulty is reduced, and the thermal protector 2 is convenient to install.

In one embodiment, the first connecting member 22 and the second connecting member 23 are made of copper-nickel alloy. The impedance of copper-nickel alloy is low, and the ohmic heating that the during operation produced is less, has reduced the influence of the heat that second connecting piece 23 produced to protector main part 21, prevents that protector main part 21 high temperature from resulting in opening circuit, has promoted thermal protector 2's electric current overcurrent value.

In one embodiment, as shown in fig. 3, the first connection member 22 is welded to the first tab 3. The processing technology is simple, and the connection is more stable.

In one embodiment, as shown in fig. 4, the first tab 3 is bent back toward the pole core after passing through the soft package housing 1. The connection of the first connection member 22 with the first tab 3 is facilitated.

The above description is only for the purpose of illustrating the preferred embodiments of the present invention and is not to be construed as limiting the utility model, and any modifications, equivalents and improvements made within the spirit and principle of the present invention are intended to be included within the scope of the present invention.
